platforms.question: Which platforms do you support?
platforms.answer: We support Taobao/Tmall, Douyin, Pinduoduo, JD, Kuaishou, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Shop, Bilibili, Shopify, Amazon, Lazada, Shopee, and 12+ platforms. More coming soon.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: We use bank-grade AES-256 encryption and are ISO27001 certified. Your data is used only for reconciliation, never shared. Export or delete anytime.

learning.question: What if I don't know how to use it?
learning.answer: No learning curve. If you can browse the web and type, you can use suanpan. First-time users get a guided tour. Need help? Customer support responds within 10 minutes.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept Alipay, WeChat Pay, and bank transfer. Enterprise plans support annual billing with discounts. Contact sales for details.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Pro and Enterprise plans include a 7-day money-back guarantee. As long as no reconciliation data has been processed, you can request a full refund.

api.question: Is there an API?
api.answer: Pro plans and above include a REST API for order data push, reconciliation result queries, webhook callbacks, and more.

contract.question: Do I need to sign a contract?
contract.answer: Enterprise plans require a formal contract and can issue VAT special invoices. Pro plans can be purchased directly online with invoices issued after order completion.

compare.question: How is this different from hiring an accountant?
compare.answer: Suanpan is an automation tool, not a human service. We automate 90% of reconciliation work. For the remaining 10% complex cases, you can handle them yourself or consult an accountant. Many accounting firms use suanpan to improve their efficiency.
